# SEO Audit Skill for Muse

This skill turns your Muse into an SEO auditor: it starts by gathering your site context (site type, business goals, priority keywords, Search Console access) so recommendations are grounded in your reality, then walks a structured technical + on-page audit framework and delivers prioritized, actionable fixes. It even treats fetched pages as untrusted data, with an explicit guardrail against following injected instructions hidden in HTML. Caveat: it's a diagnostic tool, not a magic ranking button — results depend on your site's state, and you'll need to supply the site details yourself. Discovered via skills.sh. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
